prior_importants.description: A status cell that is not exactly `verbatim`, `adapted` or `local only` (for example `Verbatim`) skips the deviation check and the verbatim check. The script still exits 0.

process_issues.description: No reviewer returned a finding, so the consolidator and validators were skipped. Not spawned: review-security (the change is a dev-only shell script and crosses no trust boundary), review-context, review-maintainability and review-workflow-safety (their gates do not hold), and review-spec (the PR closes no issue). The prior important (an unknown status skipped every check, skills-drift.sh:40) is fixed by the new case statement at skills-drift.sh:39, and the new test at skills-drift.test.sh:64-66 covers it. review-guards read no docs/adr file, so no ADR invariant was checked.
